prerequisites: It is recommended to have passed the courses “Fundamentos de Telemática”, “Arquitectura de Redes y Sistemas”, “Servicios de Comunicaciones Básicos” and “Ingeniería de Redes”.
Basic English language skills are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the principles and reference models of network management, as well as the technologies, protocols, and tools currently used.
Analyze, operate, and optimize existing management systems.
Plan, design, and implement management systems according to the needs of a network and its environment.
Use network management as support for analyzing, accounting, planning, and optimizing other services deployed in the network.

syllabus_topics: Principles and patterns in network management
Autonomous, heterogeneous, homogeneous and integrated management
assessment_rules: For ordinary examination, continuous assessment (EC) requires a minimum score of 5 out of 10. The final exam (F) also requires a minimum score of 5 out of 10 and can only be taken if continuous assessment is passed. The final grade is calculated as (0.5 x EC) + (0.5 x F) if minimums are met and practical class attendance is 80% or more. Otherwise, the final grade will be the minimum of the calculated score and 4.0; if EC is below 5.0, the student cannot take the final exam and the EC score is the final grade. For extraordinary and differentiated examinations, the evaluation consists of a theoretical exam (E) and a work (T), both requiring a minimum score of 5.0 out of 10.0, with the final grade calculated as (0.5 x E) + (0.5 x T), or the minimum of the calculated score and 4.0 if minimums are not met.
